name: Entity Weight
description: Adds a weight field to any fieldable entity type (nodes, taxonomy terms, media, paragraphs, etc.) for custom ordering.
project_description: Entity Weight adds a configurable integer weight field to any fieldable Drupal entity type - nodes, taxonomy terms, media, paragraphs, block content and custom entities - so site builders can control display order with drag-and-drop or manual weight values, without writing code. Weight is enabled per entity type and bundle from a single settings form; the field_entity_weight field (and its form-display widget) is created automatically when a bundle is enabled and removed when it is disabled or the module is uninstalled. A per-bundle drag-and-drop ordering interface lets editors reorder entities, and the weight is exposed to Views as a sort criterion. The bundled Entity Weight Views submodule adds an independent per-view-display order stored in its own table, with a reorder contextual link and multilingual per-language ordering.
